rows.v: Print-ready PDF preferred. AI, EPS, or high-resolution PNG/TIFF also accepted.
300 dpi at 100% size. Vector art (AI/EPS/PDF) is ideal and stays sharp.
CMYK for accurate print colour (RGB is converted and can shift).
3 mm on every side — extend background artwork into the bleed.
Keep text and logos ≥ 3–5 mm inside the trim so nothing is cut off.
Outline or embed all fonts before exporting.

artwork.title: Card setup
items: Supply front and back as separate pages.
For rounded corners, keep content ≥ 4 mm inside the trim.
For spot UV or foil, supply a separate 100% black mask layer.

artwork.title: Before you send
items: Double-check spelling, contact details and the final size.
Flatten transparencies, or supply layered files if we've asked for them.
